alarms.name: genai-predict-category-general-or-empty-rate
alarms.description: More than half of category predictions in the last hour were General or empty. This is the failure that once went unnoticed: an outage and a General answer look the same to the caller.

alarms.name: genai-predict-category-error-rate
alarms.description: More than 20% of category predictions failed (the model chain was exhausted or the request raised) in each of three consecutive 5-minute periods.

alarms.name: genai-predict-category-fallback-rate
alarms.description: More than half of category predictions in the last hour needed a model other than the primary. Usually a retired or rate-limited primary model; answers still arrive, but slower and from a different model than the one evaluated.

queries.name: genai/predict-category/outcomes-by-hour
queries.query:
filter event = "CLASSIFICATION_OUTCOME"
| stats count(*) as requests, sum(General) as general, sum(Empty) as empty, sum(Error) as errors, sum(Fallback) as fallbacks by bin(1h)
| sort @timestamp desc

queries.name: genai/predict-category/top-categories
queries.query:
filter event = "CLASSIFICATION_OUTCOME" and outcome = "categorised"
| stats count(*) as requests, avg(top_confidence) as avg_confidence by top_category
| sort requests desc
| limit 25

queries.name: genai/predict-category/failures-and-fallbacks
queries.query:
filter event = "CLASSIFICATION_OUTCOME" and (Error = 1 or Fallback = 1 or Empty = 1)
| fields @timestamp, outcome, error_type, models.0, models.1, ModelCalls, LatencyMs
| sort @timestamp desc
| limit 100

queries.name: genai/predict-category/latency-and-cost
queries.query:
filter event = "CLASSIFICATION_OUTCOME"
| stats pct(LatencyMs, 50) as p50_ms, pct(LatencyMs, 95) as p95_ms, avg(ModelCalls) as calls, avg(Tokens) as tokens by bin(1h)
| sort @timestamp desc

queries.name: genai/predict-category/elderly-routing-share
queries.query:
filter event = "CLASSIFICATION_OUTCOME"
| stats avg(ElderlyRouted) as elderly_routed_share, count(*) as requests by bin(1d)
| sort @timestamp desc
